description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - Details of the elected new Chairman of the Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the declaration of a Chairman for a local government authority (Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale Pradeshiya Sabha) under Section 66g of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral results and declarations at the local government level, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
